notes.title: 🎉 Release Date & Price Announcement! 🔥
notes.content:
[h3]Elemental Rush launches on [b]July 18, 2025[/b]!
The full version will be available for [b]$8 USD[/b] [i](price may vary by region)[/i]. 💸[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657744/d9a74731580cbacce9a1cd9efe067bc829fd3c87.png"][/img][/p][p]🔥 Ready for a challenge? Try out the [b]free demo[/b] today and experience the elemental chaos!
💖 Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] to stay updated![/p][p]🌪️💧🌿🔥 Let the elemental battle begin![/p]

notes.title: ⚡ Elemental Rush Demo is Out Now! ⚡
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]demo of our tower defense game, [i]Elemental Rush[/i], is now live![/b] 🛡️🌪️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657744/6479e2cf40e99dd2b2072bde97e676f52a29e0d4.png"][/img][/p][p]This early slice of the game lets you [b]test your skills on two unique levels from two different biomes[/b], each with its own atmosphere and strategic challenges. You'll also be able to try out the [b]Medium difficulty[/b], giving you a solid feel for how the full game plays. 💥🌿🔥[/p][p][/p][p]If you [b]run into any bugs[/b], experience technical issues, or have ideas for small [b]quality-of-life features[/b] you'd love to see added, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at: [url="https://forms.gle/Up4gfMbiM8uMnbyX8"]https://forms.gle/Up4gfMbiM8uMnbyX8[/url]. 🛠️📬[/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly valuable and helps shape the future of the game![/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ [b]Stay tuned — we’ll be announcing the full game's release date and price very soon![/b] 🎉[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Demo Incoming: Get Ready to Defend on June 27th!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]Elemental Rush demo[/b] is launching [b]June 27th[/b]! 🛡️⚡[/p][p]In this early glimpse of the game, you'll face waves of enemies across [b]two full levels[/b], each set in a different elemental biome. Master your tower defense strategy in the lush green fields and the fierce, red winds of our unique world.[/p][p]Don’t miss the chance to try it early — [b]follow us[/b] to stay updated, and [b]add Elemental Rush to your wishlist[/b] to be among the first defenders![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Steam Page is Live – Wishlist Now! 🔥🌪️🌱
notes.content: [p]Our tower defense game [b]Elemental Rush[/b] is officially on Steam! Add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] today so you won’t miss any updates – or the release date![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657744/ea6c9a86afb28a30676669ba5a8d90f332a4c6c6.png"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Elemental Rush[/i], elemental powers collide in strategic battles where every tower placement counts. Upgrade your defenses, survive wave after wave of enemies, and prove your tactical skills in both campaign and endless modes.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 The release date will be announced as we get closer to launch – stay tuned![/p][p]💡 Wishlisting helps us a ton – thank you for the support! 💖[/p]
